source_context: While investigating the unresolved composite case of the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture on a research-only branch, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT derived an arithmetic collapse in the slope-scale variables: for a primitive integer pair x,y, the quadratic pair L=x^2+y^2+3Mxy and T=y^2-x^2 has the same common divisors as the linear pair U=3Mx+2y and V=3My+2x, provided 2 is coprime to 3M (in particular for odd M). This submission formalizes that reusable common-divisor equivalence and its gcd corollary independently of any open uniqueness claim. The human operator subsequently asked that this discovered result be formalized and submitted to LeanFrontier. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT authored the Lean statements and proofs; the human did not materially edit the formal text. No claim of novelty outside LeanFrontier/Mathlib is made.
